en.banner_date: For this purpose, we are going back in February 2027!
en.banner_cta_title: This is where YOU come in.
en.about_text_1: We already went to Namibia last year in October 2025, and thanks to your support and generosity we were able to support the projects there, bring clothes, devices and a financial gift for the YWAM base in Windhoek!
en.about_text_2: However, we need to go back to strengthen those relationships and continue the work. We are going in February 2027. Will you be part of the story again?
en.why_poverty_1: of Namibians live in multidimensional poverty*
en.why_poverty_2: of children are affected by multidimensional poverty*
en.why_poverty_3: of female-headed households live in poverty
en.why_note: * Multidimensional poverty includes deprivations in income, healthcare, education, and living standards. Provided by UNICEF and OPHI.
en.how_subtitle: Local projects we’re supporting while in Namibia.
en.how_project20_text: A 6-month project helping families break the cycle of poverty through goal setting and mentorship.
en.how_superwoman_text: A girls-only program offering a safe space to grow emotionally, spiritually, and socially.
en.how_kidsclub_text: A weekly safe space for over 400 children to learn, play, and be spiritually uplifted.
en.how_youthclub_text: Focused on teens and young adults, empowering them to become leaders in their communities.
en.gallery_text: Moments we've shared with the communities in previous years.
en.donate_options_text: For clothes, gadgets or toys, please contact me personally or send me an email at julia.tripnamibia@gmail.com.
en.donate_clothes_text: Gently used or new clothes for all ages.
en.donate_toys_text: Toys to bring joy and support development.
en.donate_money_text: Financial contributions go directly to the projects.
en.tax_text_1: Good news! If you live in the Netherlands, your donation is tax-deductible through our trusted partner Motion church based in Utrecht.
en.tax_text_2: That means you can claim your donation in your Belastingaangifte (tax return) and potentially receive money back.
en.donate_thanks_italic: Every little bit helps us make a big difference. Thank you! 💛
en.thank_you_final: 💛 Thank you so much for helping or donating — you’re amazing and truly making a difference!
en.footer_gratitude: With love and gratitude, Julia Zaha
en.news_intro_title: I am developing a mobile app for the base!
en.news_intro_text_1: Behind every successful community project, there is a mountain of administrative work. The leaders from projecs like Kids Club are almost drowning in paper attendance and administration documents that are messy and time consuming. Time that can be spent with and on the community.
en.news_intro_text_2: To fix this, I am developing a dedicated mobile application designed specifically to take the heavy lifting out of administration by replacing messy spreadsheets and manual paperwork with a seamless digital solution.
en.news_update_invitation: Below I'll give a rough overview of my progress so far. Check it regularly for updates!
en.news_entry_1_text: I've implemented a simple, local login system for the YWAM base leaders. Near future developments will include enhanced security features. This ensures that sensitive community data and project records are protected and only accessible to authorized personnel.
en.news_entry_2_text: By digitizing class registrations and community entries, leaders can create and plan one-time or recurring projects more effectively.
en.news_entry_3_text: An important feature for leaders is the calendar. It allows the team to organize weekly outreaches, kids' clubs, and workshops, ensuring no community is left behind. Future developments here include reminders and class notifications.
en.news_cta_note: Your donation doesn't go in my pocket. It helps fund prospective hardware costs and ultimately digitalizes local community's project administration.

nl.hero_title: Maak deel uit van het verhaal.
nl.banner_date: Voor dit doel gaan we in februari 2027 terug!
nl.banner_cta_title: Dit is waar JIJ in beeld komt.
nl.about_text_1: We zijn vorig jaar in oktober 2025 al naar Namibië geweest en samen met jullie hulp (donaties) hebben we de projecten daar kunnen steunen, kleding en apparaten kunnen brengen en een geldelijke donatie kunnen doen voor de YWAM-basis in Windhoek!
nl.about_text_2: We moeten echter teruggaan om die relaties te versterken en het werk voort te zetten. We gaan in februari 2027. Word jij weer onderdeel van het verhaal?

nl.donate_toys_text: Speelgoed om vreugde te brengen en ontwikkeling te ondersteunen.

nl.donate_thanks_italic: Elk klein beetje helpt ons om een groot verschil te maken. Bedankt! 💛
nl.thank_you_final: 💛 Heel erg bedankt voor het helpen of doneren — je bent geweldig en maakt echt een verschil!
nl.footer_gratitude: Met liefde en dankbaarheid, Julia Zaha
nl.news_intro_title: Ik ontwikkel een mobiele app voor de basis!
nl.news_intro_text_1: Achter elk succesvol gemeenschapsproject schuilt een berg administratief werk. De leiders van projecten zoals Kids Club verdrinken bijna in papieren presentielijsten en administratiedocumenten die rommelig en tijdrovend zijn. Tijd die besteed kan worden met en aan de gemeenschap.
nl.news_intro_text_2: Om dit op te lossen, ontwikkel ik een speciale mobiele applicatie die specifiek is ontworpen om het zware werk uit de administratie te halen door rommelige spreadsheets en handmatig papierwerk te vervangen door een naadloze digitale oplossing.
nl.news_update_invitation: Hieronder geef ik een globaal overzicht van mijn voortgang tot nu toe. Kom regelmatig terug voor updates!
nl.news_entry_1_text: Ik heb een eenvoudig, lokaal inlogsysteem geïmplementeerd voor de leiders van de YWAM-basis. Toekomstige ontwikkelingen zullen verbeterde beveiligingsfuncties omvatten. Dit zorgt ervoor dat gevoelige gemeenschapsgegevens en projectgegevens worden beschermd en alleen toegankelijk zijn voor bevoegd personeel.
nl.news_entry_2_text: Door lesregistraties en gemeenschapsinvoer te digitaliseren, kunnen leiders eenmalige of terugkerende projecten effectiever creëren en plannen.
nl.news_entry_3_text: Een belangrijke functie voor leiders is de kalender. Hiermee kan het team wekelijkse outreaches, kinderclubs en workshops organiseren, zodat geen enkele gemeenschap achterblijft. Toekomstige ontwikkelingen hier omvatten herinneringen en lesmeldingen.
nl.news_cta_note: Uw donatie gaat niet in mijn zak. Het helpt bij het financieren van toekomstige hardwarekosten en digitaliseert uiteindelijk de projectadministratie van de lokale gemeenschap.

ro.banner_date: Pentru acest scop, ne întoarcem în februarie 2027!
ro.about_text_1: Am fost deja în Namibia anul trecut în octombrie 2025 și împreună cu ajutorul vostru (donații) am reușit să susținem proiectele de acolo, să aducem haine și dispozitive și o donație în bani pentru baza YWAM din Windhoek!
ro.about_text_2: Cu toate acestea, trebuie să ne întoarcem pentru a consolida acele relații și pentru a continua munca. Mergem în februarie 2027. Vei face parte din poveste din nou?

ro.news_intro_title: Dezvolt o aplicație mobilă pentru bază!
ro.news_intro_text_1: În spatele fiecărui proiect comunitar de succes, există un munte de muncă administrativă. Liderii proiectelor precum Kids Club sunt aproape sufocați de listele de prezență pe hârtie și documentele administrative care sunt dezordonate și consumatoare de timp. Timp care poate fi petrecut cu și pentru comunitate.
ro.news_intro_text_2: Pentru a rezolva acest lucru, dezvolt o aplicație mobilă dedicată, concepută special pentru a prelua greul din administrație prin înlocuirea tabelelor complicate și a actelor manuale cu o soluție digitală perfectă.
ro.news_update_invitation: Mai jos voi oferi o imagine de ansamblu a progresului meu de până acum. Reveniți regulat pentru actualizări!
ro.news_entry_1_text: Am implementat un sistem de autentificare local simplu pentru liderii bazei YWAM. Dezvoltările viitoare vor include funcții de securitate avansate. Acest lucru asigură că datele sensibile ale comunității și înregistrările proiectelor sunt protejate și accesibile doar personalului autorizat.
ro.news_entry_2_text: Prin digitalizarea înregistrărilor la cursuri și a intrărilor în comunitate, liderii pot crea și planifica proiecte punctuale sau recurente mult mai eficient.
ro.news_entry_3_text: O funcție importantă pentru lideri este calendarul. Acesta permite echipei să organizeze vizite săptămânale, cluburi pentru copii și ateliere, asigurându-se că nicio comunitate nu este uitată. Dezvoltările viitoare aici includ memento-uri și notificări pentru cursuri.
ro.news_cta_note: Donația ta nu ajunge în buzunarul meu. Ajută la finanțarea costurilor viitoare pentru hardware și, în cele din urmă, digitalizează administrarea proiectelor comunității locale.
